subject: Error in DPM modeling with dCRP() or stick_breaking()

messages.author: 3d203ca996f50ce8
messages.subject: Error in DPM modeling with dCRP() or stick_breaking()
parts:
Hello everyone:

I am getting the following error

Error in if (model$getVarNames(nodes = targetNode) == model$getVarNames(nodes = safeDeparse(expr,  :
  argument is of length zero


in the bulidMCMC phase (The nimbleModel() and configureMCMC() phases work)
when I try to run the following (this is a skeleton of the code) DPM model

dpm.nimble <-nimbleCode({
 
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1: M) {
      y[i,j] ~ dnorm(mu[i,j], sd=sd_y)
      mu[i,j]<- intrcp_y + sd_alpha*alpha[i]+ theta[ind[i]]*x[j]
    }
    alpha[i] ~ dnorm(0,1)
    #ind[i] ~ dcat(dp_p[1:K]) # If stick-breaking is used
  }
 
  ## Nimble stick-breaking function
  #dp.p[1:K]<- stick_breaking(q[1:(K-1)])
  ## Alternatively, Stick breaking probabilities code
  #q[1]~dbeta(1,dp_alp)
  #dp_p[1] <- q[1]
  #for(l in 2:(K-1)){
  #q[l]~dbeta(1,dp_alp)
  #dp_p[l] <- q[l]*(1-prod(1-q[1:(l-1)]))
  #}
  #dp_p[K] <- 1-prod(1-q[1:(K-1)])
  ind[1:N] ~ dCRP(dp_alp, size = N)
  #Base
  for (l in 1:K){
    theta[l]~dnorm(0,sd=sd_theta)
  }
 
  #Priors
  intrcp_y ~ dnorm(0,sd=3)
  sd_alpha ~ T(dt(0,sigma=5,df=1),0,)
  sd_theta ~ T(dt(0,sigma=5,df=1),0,)
  sd_y ~ T(dt(0,sigma=5,df=1),0,)  
  dp_alp ~ dgamma(1,1)
})

As noted in the commented part of the above code, I tried to run the model
   1) using the dCRP() function
   2) using the stick_breaking(), and
   3) hand coding the stick-breaking probabilities  (without using dCRP() or stick_breaking())

and they result in the same error message.

I also tried running the code with theta[ind[i]]*x[j] out the DPM construct (that is, instead of theta[ind[i]]*x[j], simply using theta[i]*x[j] as a random effects structure(and making appropriate other changes). This  works and I do not get this error message, Thus the error message appears to be connected with the DPM construct in the model.

I will very much appreciate any help on this as I do not know how to resolve this.

Thank you.

Sanjib Basu
